The travel issue, part three

Welcome back!

You’re home again. Today you tell the story of your trip: what you did, what went wrong, what you’re doing now and where you’ll go next. Past, present and future, all in one story.

I was walking by the river when it started to rain. Now I’m unpacking, and next time I’ll take an umbrella!

                6
                Grammar

                Past, now, future

                All the tenses you know, on one line. Read the examples, then put Kate’s sentences in the right place.

                0 / 0

                Past

                past simplefinished, at a time in the pastWe got lost. I bought a scarf.
                past continuousin the middle of an actionI was walking by the river when it started to rain.
                present perfect: fixed phrasespast, but no time; just, yet, everI’ve just got back. I haven’t unpacked yet.

                Now

                present simplealways, usually, factsI usually travel in spring. Lu loves the sea.
                present continuousat the momentI’m unpacking now. I’m still very tired.

                Future

                be going toa planI’m going to show you my photos.
                present continuousarranged: a day and a timeI’m seeing Anna on Friday.
                will / won’tdecide now, promise, thinkI think I’ll go again. I’ll send you the photos.

                Kate’s sentences: past, now or future?

                Questions

                  A story

                    8
                    Reading

                    A postcard from Rome

                    Nina is on holiday. Read her postcard, then decide: true or false?

                    0 / 0

                    Dear Sophie,

                    Greetings from Rome! I’m sitting in a little café near our hotel, and I’m writing this postcard with a cappuccino in my hand. Rome is incredibly beautiful, but it’s quite busy.

                    Yesterday we went sightseeing all day. We saw the Colosseum and took hundreds of photos. In the evening we were walking back to the hotel when we got lost! A very kind man helped us.

                    The food is really good. I’ve already tried three kinds of pizza!

                    Tomorrow we’re going to visit the Vatican, and on Sunday we’re flying home. I’ll bring you a souvenir, I promise!

                    Love, Nina

                    Sophie Brown 12 Green Street London
